svg.aria-label: Station HSB05, hanger shot blast: an octagonal blast cabinet with a round lid and two doors, with the control panel on the face between them. A monorail hoist picks the BC block on a C-hook hanger off the stand at the end of the conveyor from Baritori and carries it through the left door into the chamber; after blasting it comes out through the right door and is set down on the stand there for HSB06.
